note: RFC 4271 Section 9 requires placing a new route in Adj-RIB-In when no identical NLRI is held. TestRFC4271AdjRIBInPlacesNewRoute drives AdjRIBInManager.handleReceivedStructured with 10.0.0.0/8 then 10.1.0.0/16, asserting two distinct entries and preserved NEXT_HOP for the first, then re-announces 10.0.0.0/8 with a new NEXT_HOP as the negative check, asserting count stays 2 and the existing slot updates in place.
